gotta share the backstory, if yall will indulge me:
a neighbor from the senior apts UKVMA has our sited distro at recently got a truck, and immediately called me to get to work rescuing food. i told him we could put him to work! Northwestern Settlement is 3 blocks from his apartment bldg so when our contact there let us know they had surplus food, i figured it was too perfect. we made our first food rescue run together tonight (he said it was the first time he'd driven on the interstate since the 90s)!
